scenarios.name: Current trajectory
scenarios.summary: Continuation of current system direction, existing project pipeline and moderate technology change. This is the comparator, not a preferred outcome.

scenarios.name: Maximum local generation
scenarios.summary: Push local generation hard to expose the cost, land, grid and ecological consequences of treating import reduction as the dominant objective.

scenarios.name: Solar + storage
scenarios.summary: Test rooftop, floating and spatially screened solar with batteries, pumped storage and strategic hydro operation against Kerala's evening peak and monsoon seasonality.

scenarios.name: Integrated sovereignty
scenarios.summary: Diversified generation, distributed storage, smart tariffs, EV flexibility, cooling storage, strategic hydro and strong national-grid interconnection.

scenarios.name: Ecological sovereignty
scenarios.summary: Apply stringent habitat, watershed, forest, slope, wetland and coastal limits, then let the system model reveal the remaining feasible energy portfolio.
